data.title: Ethereum Price Prediction: What Could ETH Be Worth by 2028?
data.description: Ethereum sits more than 50% below its all-time high while JPMorgan moves onto its network, a major upgrade approaches, and ETF flows swing wildly. Whether ETH reclaims glory or revisits its June lows by 2028 depends on a fragile set of conditions finally falling into place.
